frequency_question: What proportion of formal central bank rate-hiking events successfully meet the precise bureaucratic and procedural announcement criteria without technical failure or administrative nullification?
membership_rule: Includes official monetary policy committee announcements raising benchmark rates. Excludes verbal guidance, jawboning, liquidity adjustments via reserve requirements without repo rate changes, and emergency inter-meeting moves unless formally gazetted.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named benchmark rate hikes by the specific central bank in recent cycles; all successfully met formal resolution criteria.
known_gaps: Limited strictly to recent comparable tightening phases of the same institution.
skeleton: Formal policy announcement cycles meeting statutory publication criteria versus total initiated tightening actions.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 initiated official announcements
validity_reason: Institutional announcement procedures and statutory frameworks for monetary policy changes are stable over multi-year horizons.
